title: mc-test step file (.mctest.yml)
description: A semantic mc-test test authored once and run across the matrix: the capabilities it requires plus an ordered list of steps. This authoring schema is hand-maintained (the wire/method schemas in this dir are generated); register it in IntelliJ/VS Code for *.mctest.yml autocomplete + validation.

name.description: Test name (defaults to the file name).

target.description: A target ref, or the ${matrix} placeholder filled by the mc-test.yml row selected with --target.

requires.description: Capabilities the selected driver (plus any co-selected agents) MUST satisfy; otherwise the test is SKIPPED with a reason (never a false pass).

optional.description: Capabilities to use if available; never a cause to skip.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Each is a single-key mapping { <verb>: <args> }.

matrix.description: Dimensions to expand into cases (spec 40 §4). Each entry: { values: [...] | { label: value }, bind: { step + param | setup | environment } }.

coverage.description: How many of the declared cases actually run. 'full' (default) = the whole cross-product; 'pairwise' = a covering subset (results.json still reports the FULL declared universe).

anchors.description: Named block positions the expect: clauses refer to, e.g. chest: { x: 0, y: 64, z: 0 } → pos: "chest + $face".

expect.description: The INVARIANT (spec 40 §4-§5): one oracle every generated case is judged against, evaluated against server truth after the steps run. Expected values may be functions of the case config ($dimension).

except.description: Per-case overrides of the invariant. Allowed, but each needs a written reason and every affected case is FLAGGED in results.json (spec §4).

rendering.description: A real GPU/framebuffer client is present.

worldTruth.description: Read authoritative server world/block/entity state (server agent).

pluginState.description: Assert on plugin internal state via truth.assertPluginState (server agent).

fakePlayers.description: Spawn/despawn fake players (server agent + Carpet backend).

testIdTags.description: Target emits invisible testId tags the driver can resolve.

step.description: Exactly one step verb → its args.

values.description: A list of values, or a mapping of symbolic label → value (the label is what appears in results.json and in when:).

bind.description: How the value reaches the case: a step parameter, a named setup action, or a provisioning variant (cases sharing one variant share one server boot).

step.description: Verb whose steps receive the bound parameter.

param.description: Parameter name set on those steps.

setup.description: Named fixture action applied before the steps.

environment.description: Provisioning-variant key; groups cases per boot.

position.description: A block position: { x, y, z }, "x,y,z", or an anchor expression like "chest + $face" (operators must be whitespace-separated; offsets are face names or "dx,dy,dz").

expectBranch.description: One branch of the invariant: the cases it applies to (when:) and what it demands of them. A branch with no when: applies to every case; all matching branches are ANDed.

when.description: Dimension → value (or list of values) this branch applies to. Matches the case's symbolic label or its concrete value.

because.description: The one-sentence rationale, carried into the report's expected text.

exceptEntry.description: A per-case override. Needs `case` (exact case id) or `when`, plus a written reason; the case is flagged in results.json.

when.description: Dimension → value(s), like a branch's when:.

oneOrMany.description: An assertion clause, or a list of them. block: { pos, is|absent, properties, nbt, timeoutMs } · chat: { contains|matches|regex, timeoutMs } · pluginState: { plugin, query, args, is, timeoutMs } · container: { pos, is, count, slots }.
